summary: Official ANCPI, OCPI/BCPI Cluj-Napoca, and municipal Cluj GIS evidence establish cadastral/map custodians and a public parcel-layer candidate, but live bounded anonymous requests failed with DNS/502 outcomes and no safe parcel ID plus geometry response was verified. Runtime remains held.
queryOutcomes: Separate English and Romanian discovery queries are recorded in city-948-cluj-napoca.json. They identified the ANCPI Cadastral Parcel layer, local OCPI/BCPI Cluj-Napoca custody, and the municipal GIS viewer/documentation.
requestOutcomes: TLS-verified curl attempts for ANCPI layer metadata and a bounded envelope around the exact WUP point failed with local DNS resolution error. Web inspection exposed official layer metadata in search, returned 502 for direct ANCPI and BCPI pages, and read the alternate domainInfo endpoint confirming the Cadastral Parcel schema name without geometry.
scopeLimits: Exact WUP point [46.7713200763012, 23.5921055625956] was preserved in latitude/longitude order; no coordinate shift was made.
The bounded query envelope was only a request attempt; its failure is not evidence of an exact-point miss or citywide parcel absence.
No parcel geometry, stable native parcel identity, live feature response, or retained GeoJSON sample was obtained.
National ANCPI layer metadata and local custody evidence do not establish Cluj-Napoca-specific citywide open coverage.
No owner, address, contact, titleholder, personal, tax/account, or unsafe fields were requested or retained.
Packet completion is research completion only; it does not qualify or admit a runtime adapter.
